items.title: The website's DOM stub (vilan-website/tests/support/dom.mjs) answered no `nextSibling`, so the v0.54.0 deploy's harness crashed in M187's sibling walk (`__dom_run_nodes` dereferenced `undefined`) and the fold stopped at step 8 - a std change that reaches for a NEW host member must land the website stub's member in the same order
items.kind: harness (the website's host stub; the fold)
items.status: OPEN - filed 2026-11-04 (the integrator's find at the v0.54.0 fold)
items.discussion: ui-56 (M187) replaced the per-row DOM Range with a sibling walk and updated vilan's own node DOM stub (crates/vilan-cli/tests/support/dom/stub.js) but not the website's, which is a separate repo and by design 'exactly what std emits' so that a new host call fails there loudly - it did, at the deploy instead of at the merge
items.body: Rec: (1) the lane brief rule - a change to std::web::ui/dom that adds a host call (grep the four `__dom_*` helpers' members) updates vilan-website/tests/support/dom.mjs in the same order and says so; (2) the fold's dry run could run the website harness against the integration tip BEFORE the cut (`node scripts/test.mjs` with the tip's binary on the website checkout) so the deploy cannot be the first to see it; (3) the website stub gains `nextSibling` now (done at the fold, the website's main). Sizing S.
